Margit Brinck is a nurse (Sygeplejerske) at [[ouh-odense-universitetshospital|OUH Odense Universitetshospital]] who is listed as a member of the steering committee (styregruppe) of the AFDK national quality database for atrial fibrillation in Denmark [^src1][^src2]. She appears in the AFDK annual reports for both the 2022–2023 period and the 2023–2024 period, indicating continuity in the role across at least two reporting cycles [^src1][^src2].

The 2023 report, covering the period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023, presents the composition of the steering group alongside the database's data foundation, patient population definitions, data-collection limitations, and epidemiological findings on atrial fibrillation incidence across Denmark's five regions [^src1]. The 2024 report, covering pages 66–70, situates the steering group's membership within a broader discussion of structured patient education for atrial fibrillation patients — including how Hospitalsenhed Midt implemented systematic patient education from 2012 — as well as methodological limitations of the database and AFDK's role as a national quality database under the Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab and Sundhedsstyrelsen's approval [^src2]. Margit Brinck's inclusion in both years' steering committee listings ties her directly to this ongoing national quality-improvement effort in atrial fibrillation care.

No further biographical or role-specific details about Margit Brinck are provided in the corpus beyond her listing as a nurse on the AFDK steering committee at OUH Odense Universitetshospital.
